cards.name: Offset Path
cards.summary: Live version of Object > Path > Offset Path: every path in the target is redrawn offset outward (positive ofst) or inward (negative) by a set distance, so fills and strokes fatten or shrink and corners follow the join type; the original paths stay editable. Harvest probe: ofst 10 grew the rectangle and its stroke 10 pt on every side with square corners (jntp 2). On the test plate ofst 24 swelled the box, star and circle, fused the PGD letters into one dark blob with the counters filled, and turned the open zigzag into a closed outline drawn around itself.
use_for: sticker / die-cut border behind a logo or headline (Offset Path on an extra fill below the art in the Appearance panel)
editable keyline or bleed around shapes and badges
thicken thin type or icons without changing the font weight
inset fill for inline / neon-tube type (negative offset on a second fill)
avoid: large offsets on detailed type: letters fuse into blobs and counters fill in; keep it small or apply it only to an extra fill below the type
negative offsets larger than half a shape's width make thin parts vanish
a cutter or plotter file needs the real path: use Object > Path > Offset Path or Expand Appearance

params.name: ofst
params.does: offset distance in points; positive grows the shape, negative shrinks it
params.typical: 10 (the harvested dialog value: the probe rectangle and its stroke grew 10 pt on every side); larger for a sticker border, negative to inset (negative values were not round-tripped)

params.name: jntp
params.does: corner join code; 2 (harvested default) rendered square miter corners in the harvest probe; 0 and 1 are the dialog's other joins (Round, Bevel), which code is which was not harvested

params.name: mlim
params.does: miter limit: how far a sharp miter corner may extend before it is cut off (miter joins only)

cards.scripting: item.applyEffect('<LiveEffect name="Adobe Offset Path"><Dict data="R mlim 4.0 I jntp 2 R ofst 24.0"/></LiveEffect>');  // menu route: app.executeMenuCommand('Live Offset Path') on the selection
cards.non_destructive: yes: live effect in the Appearance panel, editable or removable any time; Object > Expand Appearance bakes it
cards.cost: low: one vector offset per path, redraws fast

review.changes: ofst typical and use_for: removed invented 2-8 / 15-30 / -1 to -4 pt ranges, now the harvested 10 (probe grew 10 pt per side, measured on the render PNG); summary states the probe result and marks the plate prediction (zigzag outline) as not verified

verified.note: Box, star and circle visibly grew, the PGD letters bloated into a fused blob with filled counters, and the zigzag became a closed stroked outline around its old path, as the card says.

It draws nothing new by itself: the harvest probe rendered identically to the plain rectangle (diff 0.0), so the plate should look unchanged.

let later effects in the Appearance panel treat live type as shapes
keep a logo's wordmark editable while its effects behave as on outlines
avoid: expecting a visible change: it is a no-op on its own and on plain paths
a file that must ship without fonts: use Type > Create Outlines
stacking it after the effect that needs it: it must sit above that effect in the Appearance panel

cards.name: Outline Stroke
cards.summary: Live version of Object > Path > Outline Stroke: each stroke is converted inside the effect into a filled shape of the same width, so the effects stacked after it (Offset Path, Roughen, Pathfinder) work on the stroke's outline instead of its centre line, and the stroke weight stays editable. Alone it changes nothing visible: the harvest probe rendered identically to the plain rectangle (diff 0.0).
use_for: make Offset Path or Roughen follow a stroke's outer edge (rough hand-drawn lines, outlined icon borders)
let a Pathfinder effect on a group count strokes as shapes
logo marks that need outlined strokes for effects but an editable stroke weight
avoid: expecting a visible change: it renders the same unless another effect follows it
objects without a stroke: there is nothing to outline
cutting, embroidery or export that needs real outline paths: use Object > Path > Outline Stroke

cards.name: Add
cards.summary: Live Pathfinder Add (unite): fuses the objects in a group, layer or type object into one silhouette with no interior edges while the parts stay editable, painted with the topmost object's paint. On the overlap plate (orange rounded box behind a blue circle, overlapping, no strokes) it drew one outline-free blue silhouette of both shapes, pixel-identical to the Effect-menu control. The harvest probe on a lone filled + stroked rectangle kept only the stroke outline: Pathfinder effects need a group.
use_for: fuse overlapping letters or icon parts into one silhouette for a logo mark or badge
one outline around clustered shapes, then Offset Path for a sticker border
keep construction shapes editable while showing the united result
avoid: multicolour artwork you want to keep: everything takes the topmost object's paint (the orange box turned blue on the overlap plate); use Merge to keep colours
a single path or ungrouped selection: Illustrator warns that Pathfinder effects belong on groups, layers or type objects; group first

a plain scripted applyEffect on a group: the effect lands after the group's fill/stroke stack and gives a blank or unchanged result; move it to the head of the chain (see scripting) or apply it from the Effect menu
a real united path for cutting or export: Pathfinder panel Unite, Shape Builder or Expand Appearance

artwork whose strokes matter: they are lost

cards.scripting: group.applyEffect('<LiveEffect name="Adobe Pathfinder"><Dict data="R Mix 0.5 I Command 8 R TrapTintTolerance 0.05 R TrapMaxTint 1.0 R Precision 10.0 R TrapAspect 1.0 R TrapTint 0.4 B ExtractUnpainted 1 B RemovePoints 0 B TrapReverse 0 B ConvertCustom 1 B TrapConvertCustom 0 R TrapThickness 0.25 U DisplayString Merge"/></LiveEffect>');  // menu route: app.executeMenuCommand('Live Pathfinder Merge') on the selection Chain-order gotcha (gallery, 2026-10-13): a plain applyEffect appends the Pathfinder effect to the group's art style after its fill/stroke stack, where it acts on the group's own empty paint (blank or unchanged result); the Effect menu puts it at the head of the chain, on the group's contents. The gallery saves the file, moves the effect to the head of the group's chain, reopens and re-renders: that route matched the Effect-menu control pixel for pixel.
cards.non_destructive: yes: live effect in the Appearance panel, editable or removable any time; Object > Expand Appearance bakes it
